g.text: a: dot size = noise-floor specificity d (column 1) or own-motif read
enrichment over the other 78 TFs (column 2). Noise floor: d >= 0.04.
Motif: held-out top 10, or enrichment interval above 1. Bulk ChIP: own TF
in the top 10 of 79 inside open chromatin (CTCF HEK293T and HEK293,
NFYA K562, others HEK293). KD function: target list overlaps knockdown
responders (OR interval > 1 and above the swapped TF).
Tier 1 = >= 2 binding lines; Tier 2 = 1; Tier 3 = none.
Rows: by tier, then cells. d: Jaccard of q005 linked-peak gene lists. HEK293T; diagnostic.
